scripts.test: vitest run --config app/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config server/vitest.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config app/vite.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run i18n:check && npm run build && npm run server:build
scripts.server:dev: node server/build.mjs && DATA_DIR=./server/data ALLOWED_ORIGINS=* node server/dist/server.mjs
scripts.i18n:update: node scripts/i18n-catalogue.mjs extract && node scripts/i18n-translate.mjs scripts/i18n-source.json scripts/i18n-reused.json app/src/i18n/en.json && node scripts/i18n-catalogue.mjs build && node scripts/i18n-catalogue.mjs validate
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.i18n:audit: AUDIT_OUT=test-results/i18n-audit.json playwright test --config app/playwright.config.ts audit/crawl.spec.ts && python3 scripts/i18n-audit-report.py test-results/i18n-audit.json
